description: Canada employee take-home pay for 2026: federal tax (14% to 33%, BPA $16,452 reduced to $14,829, Canada employment amount), Ontario (with surtax and Health Premium), British Columbia (5.60% lowest rate from the July 2026 change) or Alberta tax, CPP 5.95% to $74,600, CPP2 4% to $85,000 and EI 1.63% to $68,900.
